summary: Backend-only testing. Ran the existing pytest suite (13/13 pass, demo-mode) and authored a new live end-to-end pytest module hitting the public preview URL (9/9 pass). Verified: (1) /api/health returns ai_mode='LIVE AI' with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured, (2) a clean within-limit Meals claim is processed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (ai.mode='LIVE AI', citation=MEALS-01 only, no fabricated codes), (3) deterministic LIMIT-EXCEEDED finding forces status='Needs Human Review' even when LIVE AI runs, (4) policy CRUD (create/update/delete, 409 on duplicate) works, (5) JSON import upserts by code and CSV import honors apply=false (dry-run) and aborts transactionally on errors, (6) policy:create/update/delete/import audit entries land in /api/history with claim_id=null, (7) reviewer reject without a 5-char reason returns 422. The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was never logged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~650 lines and mixes auth, claims, policy, AI, and import logic. Consider splitting into routers (auth, claims, policy) once another feature lands.
resolve_category() iterates CATEGORY_ALIASES per request; harmless at this scale but could be precomputed if the policy table grows.

policy_import does a per-row upsert without wrapping in an explicit transaction/savepoint. SQLite auto-commits at the end of the `with db()` block, but if any single upsert raised mid-loop the earlier rows would be committed. Not reachable today because validation runs first, but worth guarding with BEGIN/COMMIT if the schema evolves.
ai_review swallows all exceptions into DEMO FALLBACK; good for UX, but consider surfacing a correlation id in the explanation to aid debugging.
No rate limiting on /api/claims — each live submission costs Anthropic credits. A simple per-user cap would be prudent before production.
test_credentials: Each test run registers a unique account (live-<uuid>@example.com / password123) — no seeded reviewer; test_credentials.md left unchanged.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; policy rules created during live tests are deleted at end of their respective tests. A couple of claims and audit entries remain in the live DB (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest suites exist: /app/backend/test_server.py (offline, demo-mode, uses TestClient with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=''), and /app/backend/tests/live_e2e_test.py (hits REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and asserts LIVE AI behaviour). Live tests cost Claude credits so avoid re-running them in tight loops. All 22 tests currently green.
